verbatim_fragment: el vencimiento del plazo máximo sin haberse notificado resolución expresa, legitima al interesado o interesados para entenderla estimada por silencio administrativo
note: CODING TENSION, flagged not hidden: read alone, "legitima al interesado ... para entenderla estimada" is a faculty of the private party and would code SOMEONE. Coded NOBODY under the frozen rule that A5 is read with the code's companion provisions — art. 24(4) says the resulting act "produce efectos desde el vencimiento del plazo". The isolated-sentence reading is recorded here so the choice is visible.

verbatim_fragment: La estimación por silencio administrativo tiene a todos los efectos la consideración de acto administrativo finalizador del procedimiento
note: The positive pole of the frozen TERMS split. A completed administrative act, "a todos los efectos", with no actor named anywhere.

verbatim_fragment: La desestimación por silencio administrativo tiene los solos efectos de permitir a los interesados la interposición del recurso administrativo o contencioso-administrativo que resulte procedente
note: The negative pole. "los solos efectos de permitir" — the whole consequence is a power conferred on someone else, which does nothing until exercised. A3 codes FREE here while A5 codes SOMEONE: c981 §3's conflation, replicated on a non-German shelf.

verbatim_fragment: En los casos de estimación por silencio administrativo, la resolución expresa posterior a la producción del acto sólo podrá dictarse de ser confirmatoria del mismo
note: c978's keeper in Spanish administrative law: the consequence is realised in the lapsing party's own later inability to decide otherwise. Nobody need do anything.

verbatim_fragment: En los casos de desestimación por silencio administrativo, la resolución expresa posterior al vencimiento del plazo se adoptará por la Administración sin vinculación alguna al sentido del silencio
note: The mirror of R4 and the reason the two poles are not symmetric: after negative silence NO power is lost, and the Administration must still act for anything to happen.

verbatim_fragment: Los mismos producen efectos desde el vencimiento del plazo máximo en el que debe dictarse y notificarse la resolución expresa sin que la misma se haya expedido, y su existencia puede ser acreditada por cualquier medio de prueba admitido en Derecho, incluido el certificado acreditativo del silencio producido
note: The declared A5 tie-break instantiated: the consequence merely needs PROVING if contested, which is NOBODY. Also names a demandable dated artefact ("el interesado podrá pedirlo en cualquier momento") attached to a STATE, not to an act — consistent with c983's keeper.

verbatim_fragment: el vencimiento del plazo máximo establecido sin que se haya dictado y notificado resolución expresa no exime a la Administración del cumplimiento de la obligación legal de resolver
note: c978's FRCP 37(c)(1) limb-2 shape in an administrative register: a duty on the lapsing party that survives its own lapse and must be collected.

verbatim_fragment: los interesados que hubieren comparecido podrán entender desestimadas sus pretensiones por silencio administrativo
note: Same shape as R3, in ex officio procedures, and restricted to those who had appeared.

verbatim_fragment: En los procedimientos en que la Administración ejercite potestades sancionadoras ... se producirá la caducidad. En estos casos, la resolución que declare la caducidad ordenará el archivo de las actuaciones
note: The sharpest row in the corpus: "se producirá" is automatic, and the resolution DECLARES rather than produces. A self-executing lapse with a separate declaratory duty bolted on at the same locus (see R10).

verbatim_fragment: En los casos de prescripción, renuncia del derecho, caducidad del procedimiento o desistimiento de la solicitud ... la resolución consistirá en la declaración de la circunstancia que concurra en cada caso, con indicación de los hechos producidos y las normas aplicables
note: The declaratory limb, written in a DIFFERENT article from the lapse it declares — the opposite of the one-locus drafting c978/c981 found in FRCP 37(c)(1), FRCP 41(b) and UCC 124.

verbatim_fragment: Failing a response within the time period set or extended in accordance with paragraph 3, authorisation shall be deemed to have been granted.
note: Supranational, non-tax, non-patent. Names no actor at all — c978's AUTO-limb tell.

verbatim_fragment: Different arrangements may nevertheless be put in place, where justified by overriding reasons relating to the public interest
note: An ex ante derogation available to the Member State before any lapse, not a cure of a lapse that has happened. Excluded by the frozen Ablaufhemmung fence carried from c981.

verbatim_fragment: the time period may be extended once, by the competent authority, for a limited time. The extension and its duration shall be duly motivated and shall be notified to the applicant before the original period has expired.
note: P4's AT-RISK CANDIDATE, arriving from a register I did not expect it from: the party that will lapse may unilaterally extend the period that binds it. Killed by the frozen fence on the text's own words — "before the original period has expired" is Ablaufhemmung, not a cure. Same kill as AO § 171 at c981, different shelf.

verbatim_fragment: where applicable, a statement that in the absence of a response within the period specified, the authorisation shall be deemed to have been granted
note: A notice duty about a lapse rule, not a lapse-consequence provision. Recorded because it is the register telling the beneficiary in advance that the silence will bite — the disclosure limb c983 was looking for.

verbatim_fragment: Such different arrangements could include national rules according to which, in the absence of a response of the competent authority, the application is deemed to have been rejected, this rejection being open to challenge before the courts.
note: A recital, not operative text. Recorded because the EU legislature states the positive/negative split and its consequence — "open to challenge before the courts" — in the same words the frozen TERMS section predicted.
